reps.description: a sequence of integers representing the number of repeats for each dimension. Must have the same length as ``operand.ndim``.
constraints: must have the same length as operand.ndim
reps must contain only positive integers

output.description: A tiled array with shape ``(operand.shape[0] * reps[0], ..., operand.shape[-1] * reps[-1])``.
